title: 04a2 research strategy (extends the base Agent 4 strategy)
description: The strategy 04a2 hands to the existing render-fix-plan.js. It satisfies the base strategy contract (so the standard renderer works) and adds a `research` payload plus provenance so the plan can show the full novel-research analysis. It is ALWAYS confidence: Low, catalog_reference.title: null, and remediation_source: 04a2-remediation-research. It never contains a diff.

confidence.description: 04a2 is Low by default and never self-upgrades.

approach.description: The recommended remediation in prose. No diff — 04b implements it after approval.

title.description: Always null — there is no catalog entry.

research.description: The full 04a2 analysis, rendered into the plan's extra sections.

security_objective.description: What must become impossible after remediation.

evaluation.description: Per-candidate scoring against the fixed questions.

type.description: Distinguishes 04a2 novel research from 04a1's expanded-catalog derivation.

sources.description: Actual references if the environment provided any; empty when internally derived. Never fabricated.

external_research_available.description: false when the runtime had no web/external access — the strategy is then labelled internally derived.

promotion_candidate.description: Eligible to become a KB entry ONLY after approved+implemented+verified+cleared. Never auto-written to the KB.
